candidates.prompt: Make a strictly LOCAL edit to image1, the existing HD texture layer. Image2 is the original pixel source enlarged without interpolation, authoritative for shapes, marks, colors and illumination. Change only the tiny light marks in the lower green/teal cloth fields and the excessive mechanical details on the lower hanging fittings. Keep the cloth angles, registration, separate panels, rails, round finials, support widths, upper woven fields, lower nested curves and overall weave unchanged. The small side marks must be faint, short, soft irregular strokes matching image2; they are not crisp crosses, stars or six-ray emblems. Each stroke must differ in length, direction and brightness. Keep the existing small central upright branching stroke, but soften its ends and brightness to match image2. The side marks are much less legible than the central mark. Do not erase the markings entirely. On the lower hanging fittings, replace obvious round screw/bolt/ring embellishments and rectangular window/cage outlines with quiet irregular olive/gold highlight and dark shading patches that match image2. Retain occupied silhouette, native dark parts, thin lower curved wire and each fitting size/location. No added metal collars, new mounting rings, extra trim or hard-machined component detail. Keep the original muted maroon upper and olive-green lower fabric state, reduced brightness on lower panels. Remove the coherent paisley-like/engraved internal cloth swirl texture, retaining only very fine soft plain weave and source sparse diagonal dots. Asset: Twin Castle cut229 foreground0, exact FULL canvas aspect 110:172. Output the single isolated layer on genuine transparency, with unchanged registration and crop contacts. Preserve source illumination and restrained hand-painted Skurfa-compatible texture. No room, background, matte, cyan, newly invented logo or writing, comparison sheet, border, padding or watermark.
candidates.reason: Lower fitting cage details reduced, but native lower-panel dark illumination is not sufficiently retained and the pale marks still resolve as repeated cross-like strokes.
